chunks: But those for whom a good reward had been fore-ordained by Us, will be far removed from it,
ai.seo_question: What does 'Al-Husna' refer to in this verse and who is kept away from it?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse clarifies that 'Al-Husna' (the Good) specifically denotes Paradise, ensuring that those predestined for it are eternally shielded from the Hellfire. This distinction underscores the divine justice where the righteous are not merely spared punishment but are actively kept away from it, reflecting the concept of *Tayyib* (purity) in their spiritual state.
